:::{#thm-neg-agreement-harmonic}
#### Negative agreement is a harmonic mean

For an agreement table with $d > 0$,
the negative agreement (@def-negative-agreement)
is the harmonic mean (@def-harmonic-mean)
of the estimated negative predictive value and specificity
(@def-agreement-test-measures):

$$
p_{\text{neg}} = H\paren{\Est{\text{NPV}}, \Est{\text{specificity}}}
$$ {#eq-neg-agreement-harmonic}

:::

::: proof

By @exr-neg-agreement-harmonic,
the harmonic mean equals $2d / (2d + b + c)$,
which is $p_{\text{neg}}$ by @def-negative-agreement.

:::
